stories.title: Nvidia's board rules out reinstating Jensen Huang, ousted as CEO amid espionage and affair scandals
stories.summary:
Jensen Huang, Nvidia's cofounder and CEO of 33 years, is out after the company investigated his affair with a woman US intelligence links to a Chinese spy plot, and the board says it won't bring him back.

- The NYT says the woman is a recruit of China's Ministry of State Security and a top executive at a Singapore AI cloud firm accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China. The relationship reportedly helped route $7.5B in Nvidia AI chips to Chinese firms
- WIRED's sources say the board's main problem was Huang's "lack of candor," amid allegations of multiple affairs, including one with a direct report
- The board chair said Nvidia is not considering reinstating him, despite pressure from Trump, Elon Musk, Silicon Valley executives, and some Nvidia employees
- CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and promised across-the-board pay raises and more equity at her first all-hands. Trump still promotes former Apple CEO Tim Cook as a possible successor
- Huang agreed to testify before Congress, and Democrats have opened a second investigation into Nvidia's China sales and what they call Huang's "scheme" with Trump
- Nvidia stock slid on the scandal, and investors proposed a class action

stories.title: Anthropic debuts as a public company worth more than $1 trillion after the biggest IPO ever
stories.summary:
Anthropic is now a public company worth more than $1 trillion, and was briefly valued at more than $2 trillion on its debut, per Engadget.

- It priced shares at $83, above its $70-$78 range, raising $107.3 billion and beating SpaceX's $85.7 billion record for the biggest IPO ever
- The public S-1 shows soaring revenue and enterprise adoption alongside heavy losses (about $8 billion last year)
- The seven co-founders keep a combined 50.1% of the vote on most matters, and each planned to sell about $250M of shares
- Amazon is set to make far more from the IPO than Anthropic's VC backers, and the SpaceXAI deal is bigger than previously known
- Risk factors warn that Anthropic's own AI could pose an existential risk
- Blackstone expects credit agencies to rate Anthropic high "junk" after listing, per the FT

stories.title: NYC, LA, and Chicago school districts weigh alternatives to Google after its AI-in-Search policy backlash
stories.summary:
America's three largest school districts, in New York City, Los Angeles, and Chicago, are all discussing alternatives to Google. The talks follow a backlash over Google's plan to cut off Search at schools that disable its AI tools.

- Google had threatened that schools dropping its AI would lose Search too, since AI Overviews are built into Search. It later tried to walk that policy back
- Google's own employees have joined the criticism: the Alphabet Workers Union objected to Google requiring its AI tools be bundled with Search
- Parents and educators worry that easy, machine-generated answers are leaving kids less capable
- NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani and former FTC chair Lina Khan accused Google of acting as an unregulated monopoly
- DuckDuckGo has been courting frustrated schools with its search engine and options to disable AI features

stories.title: Google will keep Gemini chat logs for two months, even with history turned off
stories.summary: Google says it will retain Gemini chat logs for two months even for users who have turned Gemini history off. Gizmodo reports that the company frames the change as being for users' own good.

sources.title: Google to Keep AI Chat Logs for Two Months, Even With Gemini History Turned Off

stories.title: The Fed is worried AI agents could trigger a bank run in minutes
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve is worried that AI agents moving money for users could trigger bank runs within minutes, Gizmodo reports. Meanwhile, the AI industry's mountain of debt is finding its way into life insurance.

sources.title: The Fed Is Worried AI Agents Could Trigger a Bank Run

stories.title: xAI releases Grok Bot 1.0, letting agents work across whole teams and act unprompted
stories.summary: xAI released Grok Bot 1.0, the first numbered version of its persistent-agent product. According to xAI, bots now work with an entire team, take on work without being asked, and finish tasks faster.

sources.title: Introducing Grok Bot 1.0

stories.title: Gallup finds over a third of Gen Z rely on AI for friendship, and AI companion users are lonelier
stories.summary: A new Gallup report finds more than a third of Gen Z rely on AI for friendship, and young people who use AI as a social companion or have only online friends face higher odds of loneliness than those who don't, Wired reports.

sources.title: Over a Third of Gen Z-ers Rely on AI for Friendship

stories.title: OpenAI works with NATO and allied cyber agencies to help defenders find and fix vulnerabilities
stories.summary: OpenAI says it is working with NATO and allied cyber agencies to help trusted defenders use AI to find vulnerabilities, test fixes, and protect essential systems. The company-published post doesn't detail which models or access programs are involved.

sources.title: Strengthening NATO and allied cyber defenses with AI

stories.title: Disney Imagineers build AI-powered "Star Wars" alien Audio-Animatronics with AWS
stories.summary: Disney Imagineering worked with AWS to build three AI-powered Audio-Animatronic Anzellan characters from "Star Wars," each with its own personality, that will interact with guests in Disney parks.

sources.title: Disney Imagineers Have Built AI-Powered ‘Star Wars’ Alien Audio-Animatronics With AWS
